name: Barbell Sumo Squat
steps: Set a barbell securely across your upper back, step wide outside shoulder width, and turn your toes out roughly 45 degrees.
Brace your core, lift your chest, and actively push your knees out over your toes.
Bend your hips and knees together to sit smoothly down until your thighs reach roughly parallel to the floor.
Drive evenly through your midfoot and heels to stand tall and squeeze your glutes.
tips: Keep each knee tracking directly in line with its angled toes without caving inward.
Keep your torso upright and heels grounded flat throughout the squat.
